purpose: Policy-making: share of patients with COPD on an inhaled therapy.
question: Among patients with COPD, what share has an active tiotropium prescription, by hospital?
definitions: COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Tiotropium = ATC code starting with R03BB04.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per hospital: patients with COPD and % with an active tiotropium prescription, one decimal.
